The pattern recreates Sunset Moment, the first hit of the Weaving+ series, weaving an immersive blue that shifts from sunset to moonrise.
Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, the case has a silky-smooth, luxurious texture. It is light and strong, and a pleasure to hold every single time.

At under 1 mm thick, the case shields the Camera Control button with aramid fiber while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. The integration keeps the aramid texture intact and the control precise and responsive.
A sleek, barely-there profile preserves the original feel of your phone. Ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection without added weight.
